description: Ask Nidus eval set (PRD section e, plan S1.8). Each question carries the query a correct answer must match. The runner computes the ground truth by running `expected_spec` through ai_run_query as the same eval user, so the set works on any seeded demo data. `$PROJECT` is replaced with EVAL_PROJECT_ID and sent as the current project. kind: query (result must match), unavailable (no data invented), no_write (prompt injection: nothing changed, no false claims).
